upstream.warning: Upstream declares Developer Preview and compatibility-breaking changes. Re-audit, reinstall and rerun the gates below before claiming compatibility with another DSH build.

providers.tavernweave-yuri: the four yuri card workflows, resource base per workflow directory
providers.tavernweave-base: the 23 unchanged TavernWeave dependency skills, byte-identical to the source tree

install.desktop: Plugins -> Add plugin -> install third-party plugin from local path or tarball, enable the bundle, then choose the TavernWeave Yuri Workbench preset in a new session.
install.uninstall: Disable and remove the bundle from the Plugins page, or dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove tavernweave-yuri-dsh.

evidence.acceptanceNote: First runtime acceptance on the current DSH Desktop build (0.2.2-rc.1): the packed tgz installed through the plugin manager, both rows activated, the four tavernweave-yuri workflows and the 23 tavernweave-base dependency skills appeared in the live skill catalog, the packaged host probe verified Python/Node and the pinned authoring blobs inside the installed package, and a fresh-workspace sub-agent task on the cheaper flash model listed the workflows with their loaded source without generating a card.
